next_step: Finalize Dedicated POC scope and sign SOW for 6-week trial.
notes: Stage summary: started with Hosted API eval (Jan) -> satisfied with latency/cost for dev flows -> now pushing Dedicated for production burst and data isolation.
Motivation: reduce per-token cost for high-volume support assistant and to get predictable throughput for scheduled nightly vector index rebuilds.
Requirements (spoken): 1500 RPS aggregate peak for embeddings + chat; p95 latency < 200ms for short chats (<=256 tokens); nightly index rebuilds throughput target 500k tokens/hr.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, and be able to restrict logs retention to 90 days for EU customers.
POC ask: 6-week Dedicated POC in VPC (dev->staging->prod lane). Canary policy for new model variants and region failover plan (us-east primary, eu-west warm standby).

Routing plan discussed: primary route to cheapest compatible model variant (quantized) for cost-sensitive traffic; fallback to higher-accuracy variant if quality regressions detected; cross-region failover if capacity throttle or region outage.

Canary details: 5% traffic for canary, ramp to 25% after 48h if latency and NPS-quality metrics remain within thresholds; auto-rollback trigger: >2.5% drop in eval benchmark or >20% increase in error-rate or sustained p95>350ms for 1h.

Model variants: open-weights quantized variant (fast, lower cost), full-precision variant (higher quality) + cached KV path for session warm starts. Team wants deterministic fallback mapping per route.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histogram, roll-forward/roll-back hooks in Console. Want webhook on regression + daily quality report tied to prompt suite.
Pricing convo: AE shared Dedicated starter SOW and committed capacity tiers. CFO wants a 12-month cap option; asking for a 6-week trial SOW that converts/reconciles into committed credits.
Quote from Maya on call: 'We need predictable latency for customer-facing chat during peak hours — can't have model swaps silently increase response time.'
Internal notes: SE (Diego) to validate autoscaling burst behavior and KV-cache warmup times. Ask infra to simulate eu-west failover during POC week 3.
Legal: in parallel with DPA review — security sent initial questionnaire (SEC-441). Need data residency confirmation for EU tenants (subset of customers).

Action items: 1) Provide POC SOW draft with canary + rollback clauses (due 2026-03-12). 2) Load test plan and synthetic traces to reproduce peak RPS. 3) Demo of console routing/policy UI with traffic-split rules.
